a.title: InfraTrust report warns of exploited flaws in critical network infrastructure

b.lede: Security researchers at Anthropic have developed an exploit for a critical Linux kernel vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to remotely execute commands as root on servers running Multipath TCP (MPTCP) listeners. [...]
b.title: Critical Linux kernel flaw allows remote root attacks on MPTCP servers
